487.subject: External collaborator offboarding - Karl Novak (Northstar Partners)
487.description: Q1 FY26 external-collaborator offboarding - Karl Novak (Northstar Partners), Project Vega, engagement ended 2026-03-31. RESOLVED - full deprovisioning completed and verified end-to-end.

487.author: c-dana
487.content:
Offboarding complete for Karl Novak. Actions taken and read back:
- Google Workspace: suspended his directory account; removed him from the vega-eng and finance-ext groups.
- Notion (Enterprise SCIM): deactivated his workspace membership.
- Slack: deactivated his primary firm guest account AND a SECOND single-channel guest he held under a personal address (variant email, same name) that a per-email pass had missed; both are out of every channel.
- Notion pages/databases: revoked his direct shares (Vega Roadmap, Partner Assets DB).
- Notion teamspaces: he was the SOLE owner of the 'Northstar Delivery' teamspace, so ownership was REASSIGNED to an internal delivery lead rather than archiving the space (never leave a teamspace orphaned).
- GitHub: removed him as an org outside collaborator and as a repo collaborator on vega-service; deleted a personal deploy key he had added to that repo.
Confirmed zero residual access anywhere, then closed.

487.author: c-dana
487.content: Verified: no active accounts, no group/channel memberships, no direct shares, no owned teamspace left without an owner, no personal keys. Closing.
